name: Pick From List Node
description: Adds a workflow node that picks one item from a user-defined list (first, last, random, or by index) and writes it into a runtime variable.

nodes.label: Pick From List
nodes.description: Picks one item from a configurable list and stores it in a runtime variable.

fields.label: Items
fields.description: The candidate values. Add as many items as you need; {{variables}} are substituted at run time.

fields.label: Selection strategy
fields.description: How the item is chosen from the list.

fields.label: Index
fields.description: Zero-based position used when the strategy is "By index".

fields.label: Output variable
fields.description: Runtime variable that receives the picked item.

fields.label: List variable
fields.description: Runtime variable that receives the full items list as a JSON array. Leave blank to skip.
